compatible.description: Device-tree compatible string; used to locate config file and identify hardware variant.

modem_device.description: Path to the modem's serial device node.

baud_rate.description: Serial port speed (baud rate) in bps.

power_gpio.description: GPIO number for manual modem power control (if hardware supports it).

network_interface.description: Network interface name to associate with the modem (e.g., 'wwan0').

apn.description: Access Point Name for mobile data connection.

apn_username.description: Username for APN authentication (if required by carrier).

apn_password.description: Password for APN authentication (if required by carrier).

pin.description: SIM PIN code for unlocking (must be set if SIM requires PIN).

auto_connect.description: Enable automatic data connection upon successful network registration.

sms_notification.description: Enable SMS delivery notifications (requires ModemManager or ofono integration).

signal_monitor.description: Enable periodic signal strength reporting (RSSI, RSRP, etc.).

init_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for modem initialization and AT command responses.

connect_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for data connection (PPP/NAT) establishment.

firmware_path.description: Absolute path to QDL firmware image file for EG25 flashing (optional).

auto_update_firmware.description: Enable automatic firmware flashing on boot if firmware_path is set.
